feed.title: Type IL Cement & Concrete Index: daily digest
feed.subtitle: A living index of standards, research, guidance, field experience and news on Type IL portland-limestone cement (ASTM C595 / AASHTO M 240, 5-15% limestone) and concrete made with it. Updated daily.

entry.title: October 29, 2026: 11 new resources
entry.content:
11 new resources in the Type IL Cement & Concrete Index.

Carbon, GWP and EPDs

  • New Cementitious Materials PCR Advances Environmental Reporting (new industry-average EPDs underway) (ACA, News, 2026-10-06)

Precast, floors, bridges

  • Development of Wet-Mix Shotcrete with Portland-Limestone Cement (Zhang, Zhang, Morgan, Mindess; Materials Journal 123(2)) (ACI, Paper, 2026-03)
  • Performance evaluation of limestone-blended cement and cellulose nanomaterials in 3D concrete printing (Case Studies in Construction Materials, Paper, 2025-05)
  • Developing 3D Printable Concrete using Quarry By-Products as Partial Replacement for Cement (Type IL) (Purdue e-Pubs (conference paper), Paper, 2025)

Canada and Europe

  • Blended Cements and Supplementary Cementitious Materials policy document (GCCA, Policy document, 2025-07)
  • Limestone filler (clinker substitutes) (GCCA, Guide)

State DOT acceptance

  • RSP 901-M-069 Portland Cements and Blended Cements (Type IL limestone capped at 10%) (INDOT, Spec, 2025-12-01)
  • Qualified Producer List of Cement Plants (IDOT (Illinois), Approved list, 2026)
  • Assessment of Limestone Blended Cements for Transportation Applications (final report, FHWA-GA-17-13-09) (USDOT ROSA P, Report, 2017-09)

Durability

  • Tech Bulletin: Preventing Scaling of Concrete with Portland Limestone Cement (Michigan Concrete Association, Tech bulletin, 2024-07)

Standards and specifications

  • Guide to Selecting Exposure Classes and Requirements for Concrete (NRMCA, Guide)

Index note: Added 11 resources (R54-R64): Type IL shotcrete and 3D printing studies, ACA PCR news, GCCA documents, INDOT and IDOT cement specs/lists, Michigan scaling bulletin, NRMCA exposure class guide, USDOT limestone blended cement report. Updated DOT, durability, applications, carbon, international takeaways and research gaps.
